title: Gà xào sả ớt (lemongrass chilli chicken)
steps: Cook the rice according to the packet.
Very finely chop the lemongrass, garlic, shallot and chilli, cut the chicken into pieces and marinate with half of it, the fish sauce, sugar and turmeric.
Fry the rest of the aromatics in the oil for 1 minute, add the chicken and fry for 8–10 minutes until golden.
Blanch the beans for 4 minutes and toss them in briefly.
Sprinkle with coriander and serve with rice.
